name: Flaming Flower Stamen
description: The stamen of a fiercely burning flower. Even after being extinguished, it still emits heat.
fullDescription: The stamen of a fiercely burning flower. Even after being extinguished, it still emits heat. It is said that this plant slowly develops intelligence and unique behaviors as it accumulates elemental energy.
sources: Recommendation: Found at the Thousand Winds Temple
